as_of_note: Voting control from 10-K / charters. Economic stakes are 13F as of 2026-06-30 where cited. Institutions are not controllers. No recursion into who owns BlackRock.

entities.name: CNN
entities.control_summary: No controlling shareholder at the public parent. Editorial control sits with Warner Bros. Discovery management.

entities.name: CNN Worldwide
entities.control_summary: Operating division of Warner Bros. Discovery.

entities.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
entities.control_summary: One-share-one-vote public company. No dual-class controller. Economic ownership is widely held by index institutions.
entities.notes: Parent of CNN, HBO, Discovery, Warner Bros. film/TV.

entities.name: Fox News
entities.control_summary: Voting control of the public parent sits with the Murdoch family through Fox Corporation Class B shares.

entities.name: Fox News Media
entities.control_summary: Division of Fox Corporation.

entities.name: Fox Corporation
entities.control_summary: Dual-class. Murdoch family holds a controlling voting interest via Class B common stock.
entities.notes: Also parent of Fox Business, Fox Sports, Tubi.

entities.name: New York Post
entities.control_summary: Voting control of News Corp sits with the Murdoch family through Class B shares.

entities.name: The Wall Street Journal
entities.control_summary: Voting control of News Corp sits with the Murdoch family through Class B shares.

entities.name: Dow Jones & Company
entities.control_summary: Wholly owned subsidiary of News Corp.
entities.notes: Publisher of The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch.

entities.name: News Corporation
entities.control_summary: Dual-class. Murdoch family holds a controlling voting interest via Class B (NWS). Class A (NWSA) is the widely held economic share.
entities.notes: Also parent of HarperCollins and News UK titles.

entities.name: The Guardian
entities.control_summary: Owned by the Scott Trust. No shareholders. No public equity.

entities.name: Guardian News & Media
entities.control_summary: Operating company for The Guardian and The Observer, owned by Guardian Media Group.

entities.name: Guardian Media Group
entities.control_summary: Wholly owned by The Scott Trust Limited.

entities.name: The Scott Trust Limited
entities.control_summary: Sole owner of Guardian Media Group. Not a public company. No residual claimants.

entities.name: Washington Examiner
entities.control_summary: Privately owned. Ultimate control sits with Philip Anschutz via Clarity Media Group.

entities.name: MediaDC
entities.control_summary: Publishing unit of Clarity Media Group.

entities.name: Clarity Media Group
entities.control_summary: Private media holding company controlled by Philip Anschutz.

entities.name: The New York Times
entities.control_summary: Voting control of The New York Times Company sits with the Ochs-Sulzberger family through Class B shares.

entities.name: The New York Times Company
entities.control_summary: Dual-class. Class B stock, held almost entirely by the Ochs-Sulzberger family, elects a majority of the board.

entities.name: The Washington Post
entities.control_summary: Privately owned. Jeff Bezos is the sole beneficial owner through Nash Holdings.

entities.name: Nash Holdings LLC
entities.control_summary: Acquisition vehicle for The Washington Post. Owned by Jeff Bezos.
entities.notes: Purchased the Post from Graham Holdings in 2013.

entities.name: Murdoch family
entities.control_summary: Controls Fox Corporation and News Corp through dual-class Class B stock held in family trusts.
entities.notes: Economic stake is smaller than voting stake.

entities.name: Ochs-Sulzberger family
entities.control_summary: Controls The New York Times Company through Class B shares.

entities.name: Jeff Bezos
entities.control_summary: Sole owner of Nash Holdings / The Washington Post.

entities.name: Philip Anschutz
entities.control_summary: Sole controlling owner of Clarity Media Group.

entities.name: BlackRock
entities.control_summary: Passive institutional holder. 13F positions are economic exposure, not editorial control.

entities.name: Vanguard
entities.control_summary: Passive institutional holder. Index-fund economic exposure, not a media controller.
entities.notes: Multiple Vanguard adviser entities collapsed for display.

entities.name: State Street
entities.control_summary: Passive institutional holder. Economic exposure, not editorial control.
